arxiv-2106-03123.title: The θ \theta -density in Arakelov geometry
arxiv-2106-03123.creator: Xiaozong WANG
arxiv-2106-03123.description: Abstract . In this article, we construct a θ \theta -density for the global sections of ample Hermitian line bundles on a projective arithmetic variety. We show that this density has similar behaviour to the usual density in the Arakelov geometric setting, where only global sections of norm smaller than 1 1 are considered.

arxiv-2111-13531.title: Radial overlap correction to superallowed 0 + → 0 + 0^{+}\to 0^{+} nuclear β \beta decays using the shell model with Hartree-Fock radial wave functions

arxiv-2111-13531.description: Abstract The radial overlap correction, δ R ​ O \delta_{RO} is re-examined for 30 superallowed 0 + → 0 + 0^{+}\to 0^{+} nuclear β \beta decays using the shell model with Hartree-Fock (HF) radial wave functions. Our mean-field calculation is based on the effective Skyrme interaction including Coulomb, Charge-Symmetry-Breaking (CSB) and Charge-Independence-Breaking (CIB) terms.

arxiv-2312-04440.description: Abstract The performance of automatic summarization models has improved dramatically in recent years. Yet, there is still a gap in meeting specific information needs of users in real-world scenarios, particularly when a targeted summary is sought, such as in the useful aspect-based summarization setting targeted in this paper.

arxiv-2403-14923.creator: Peter Buser, Eran Makover, Bjoern Muetzel
arxiv-2403-14923.description: Abstract In this paper we continue to investigate the systolic landscape of translation surfaces started in [ CHMW ] . We show that there is an infinite sequence of surfaces ( S g k ) k (S_{g_{k}})_{k} of genus g k g_{k} , where g k → ∞ g_{k}\to\infty with large systoles.

arxiv-2406-05155.title: Multifractality and Hyperuniformity in Quasicrystalline Bose-Hubbard Models with and without Disorder
arxiv-2406-05155.creator: Masahiro Hori 1,2, Takanori Sugimoto 3, Yoichiro Hashizume 4, and Takami Tohyama 2
arxiv-2406-05155.description: Abstract Clarifying similarities and differences in physical properties between crystalline and quasicrystalline systems is one of central issues in studying quasicrystals. To contribute to this, we apply multifractal and hyperuniform analyses to nonuniform spatial patterns in the Bose-Hubbard model on the Penrose and Ammann-Beenker tilings.

arxiv-2408-14968.title: MRSE: An Efficient Multi-modality Retrieval System for Large Scale E-commerce
arxiv-2408-14968.creator: Hao Jiang, Haoxiang Zhang, Qingshan Hou, Chaofeng Chen, Weisi Lin, Jingchang Zhang, Annan Wang
arxiv-2408-14968.description: Abstract 1 Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore 2 National University of Singapore (NUS), Singapore 3 Shopee, Singapore {jianghao907, haoxiang.z.f, houqingshancv, chaofenghust}@gmail.com, Abstract Providing high-quality item recall for text queries is crucial for developing search systems in large-scale e-commerce. Current solutions employ Embedding-based Retrieval Systems (ERS) to embed queries and items into a low-dimensional space.

arxiv-2409-07222.title: Dual-Step Optimization for Binary Sequences with High Merit Factors
arxiv-2409-07222.creator: Blaž Pšeničnik, Rene Mlinarič, Janez Brest, Borko Bošković
arxiv-2409-07222.description: Abstract The problem of finding aperiodic low auto-correlation binary sequences (LABS) presents a significant computational challenge, particularly as the sequence length increases. Such sequences have important applications in communication engineering, physics, chemistry, and cryptography. This paper introduces a novel dual-step algorithm for long binary sequences with high merit factors.

arxiv-2502-15942.title: Faster calculations of optical trapping using neural networks trained by T-matrix data: an application to micro and nanoplastics
arxiv-2502-15942.creator: Shadi Rezaei, David Bronte Ciriza, Abdollah Hassanzadeh, Fardin Kheirandish, Pietro G. Gucciardi, Onofrio M. Maragò, Rosalba Saija, Maria Antonia Iatì
arxiv-2502-15942.description: Abstract We employ neural networks to improve and speed up optical force calculations for dielectric particles. The network is first trained on a limited set of data obtained through accurate light scattering calculations, based on the Transition matrix method, and then used to explore a wider range of particle dimensions, refractive indices, and excitation wavelengths.

arxiv-2504-13252.title: Magnetic noise in macroscopic quantum spatial superposition
arxiv-2504-13252.creator: Sneha Narasimha Moorthy 1, 2, Andrew Geraci 3, Sougato Bose 4, Anupam Mazumdar 5
arxiv-2504-13252.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sneha Narasimha Moorthy 1, 2, Andrew Geraci 3, Sougato Bose 4, Anupam Mazumdar 5. In this paper, we will show how random fluctuations in the magnetic field gradient will jitter the paths of a matter-wave interferometer randomly, hence, decohere the quantum superposition. To create a large spatial superposition with nanoparticles, we envisage embedding a spin in a nanoparticle as a defect and applying an inhomogeneous magnetic field as in a Stern-Gerlach-type experiment to create a macroscopic quantum superposition.

arxiv-2507-19899.title: A Gold Standard Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Depression Detection and Explanation in Social Media using LLMs
arxiv-2507-19899.creator: Prajval Bolegave, Pushpak Bhattacharya
arxiv-2507-19899.description: Abstract Early detection of depression from online social media posts holds promise for providing timely mental health interventions. In this work, we present a high-quality, expert-annotated dataset of 1,017 social media posts labeled with depressive spans and mapped to 12 depression symptom categories. Unlike prior datasets that primarily offer coarse post-level labels Cohan et al.

arxiv-2509-02787.title: The Berger-Wang formula for order-preserving homogeneous maps on cones
arxiv-2509-02787.creator: Brian Lins, Aljoša Peperko
arxiv-2509-02787.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Brian Lins, Aljoša Peperko. We prove that the joint spectral radius and generalized spectral radius are equal for any bounded, equicontinuous family of order-preserving, homogeneous maps on a polyhedral cone. We also consider conditions which guarantee that the semigroup generated by a family of order-preserving, homogeneous maps is bounded when its generalized spectral radius r ⁡ ( 𝒜 ) = 1 r(\mathcal{A})=1 . Finally, we extend the notions of joint and generalized spectral subradii to the setting of homogeneous maps on wedges.

arxiv-2509-22969.title: Shape-Informed Clustering of Multi-Dimensional Functional Data via Deep Functional Autoencoders
arxiv-2509-22969.creator: Samuel Singh, Shirley Coyle, Mimi Zhang
arxiv-2509-22969.description: Abstract We introduce FAEclust , a novel functional autoencoder framework for cluster analysis of multi-dimensional functional data, data that are random realizations of vector-valued random functions. Our framework features a universal-approximator encoder that captures complex nonlinear interdependencies among component functions, and a universal-approximator decoder capable of accurately reconstructing both Euclidean and manifold-valued functional data.

arxiv-2602-21638.title: Multi-dimensional Assessment and Explainable Feedback for Counselor Responses to Client Resistance in Text-based Counseling with LLMs
arxiv-2602-21638.creator: 1 st Anqi Li, 2 nd Ruihan Wang, 4 th Zhaoming Chen, 4 th Yuqian Chen, 5 rd Yu Lu, 6 th* Yi Zhu, 7 th* Yuan Xie, 8 th* Zhenzhong Lan
arxiv-2602-21638.description: Abstract Effectively addressing client resistance is a sophisticated clinical skill in psychological counseling, yet practitioners often lack timely and scalable supervisory feedback to refine their approaches. Although current NLP research has examined overall counseling quality and general therapeutic skills, it fails to provide granular evaluations of high-stakes moments where clients exhibit resistance.

pmc-10745444.creator: Ting Li, Na Luo, Jiewen Fu, Jiaman Du, Zhiying Liu, Qi Tan, Meiling Zheng, Jiayue He, Jingliang Cheng, Dabing Li, Junjiang Fu, Qibin Geng
pmc-10745444.description: NRP1/CD304 is a typical membrane-bound co-receptor for the vascular endothelial cell growth factor (VEGF), semaphorin family members, and viral SARS-CoV-2. Cordycepin (CD) is a natural product or active gradient from traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) from Cordyceps militaris Link and Ophiocordyceps sinensis (Berk.).

pmc-11379103.title: A Successful Laparoscopic Appendectomy for an Adult Male Patient with Osteogenesis Imperfecta
pmc-11379103.creator: Mohamed I. Farid, Azza Baz, Mohamed Emad El-Dein Hemdan, Taghreed Abdelhamid, Diyaa Ebrahim, Fadl Fayed, Emad Abdel-Haleem
pmc-11379103.description: BackgroundOsteogenesis imperfecta (OI) is a genetic connective tissue disease defined by the loss of bone mass and density, which makes the bones more brittle and more likely to fracture over time. Bone deformity and articular instability are the subsequent symptoms.Case reportThis 25-year-old man had malformed lower limbs and trouble walking due to OI and dwarfism.

pmc-11458051.title: Public awareness of gastric cancer risk factors and screening behaviours in Shijiazhuang, China: A community-based survey
pmc-11458051.creator: Qian Wang, Xiao-Ci He, Lian-Xia Geng, Shu-Lin Jiang, Chuan-Jie Yang, Kai-Yue Xu, Shu-Fang Shen, Wen-Wen Cao, Wei Qi, Shu-Ping Zhao, Peivand Bastani, Pengpeng Ye, Pengpeng Ye
pmc-11458051.description: BackgroundReducing exposure to risk factors and screening represent 2 major approaches to gastric cancer (GC) prevention, but public knowledge GC risk factors and screening behaviour remain unknown. We aimed to investigate public awareness of GC risk factors, adherence to screening, and barriers hindering screening practices in China.

pmc-11477719.title: Effect of Er,Cr:YSGG Laser Irradiation on the Surface Modification and Cell Adhesion on Titanium Discs: An In Vitro Study
pmc-11477719.creator: Takahiko Shiba, Kailing Ho, Xuehao Ma, Ye Won Cho, Chia-Yu Chen, David M Kim, Marco Portelli, George Eliades
pmc-11477719.description: This study evaluates the potential of erbium, chromium-doped:yttrium, scandium, gallium, and garnet (Er,Cr:YSGG) laser irradiation to modify the titanium surface for optimal seeding of fibroblasts and osteoblasts in the treatment of peri-implantitis. Titanium discs were treated using the Er,Cr:YSGG laser, an ultrasonic device with a stainless tip, or titanium scalers.

pmc-11701988.title: Patients With Shoulder Labral Tears Search the Internet to Understand Their Diagnoses and Treatment Options
pmc-11701988.creator: Gary George, Muhammad J. Abbas, Joshua P. Castle, Michael A. Gaudiani, Matthew Gasparro, Noel O. Akioyamen, Matthew Corsi, Brittaney Pratt, Stephanie J. Muh, T. Sean Lynch
pmc-11701988.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeTo analyze the most frequently searched questions associated with shoulder labral pathology and to evaluate the source-type availability and quality.MethodsCommon shoulder labral pathology-related search terms were entered into Google, and the suggested frequently asked questions were compiled and categorized. In addition, suggested sources were recorded, categorized, and scored for quality of information using JAMA (The Journal of the American Medical Association) benchmark criteria.

pmc-12721758.title: Dentinogenic Ghost Cell Tumor in an Elderly Female: A Rare Case Report
pmc-12721758.creator: Akunchan Shrestha, Iccha Kumar Maharjan, Pragya Regmee, Abhinaya Luitel, Mehul Rajesh Jaisani, Neetu Jain, Shristi Maharjan, Asha Rai, Regina Dahait, Numa Limbu, Hannah Wesley
pmc-12721758.description: Dentinogenic ghost cell tumor (DGCT) is an uncommon odontogenic neoplasm that accounts for less than 0.5% of all tumors with odontogenic origin. Its rarity, along with identical radiological and clinical features as other odontogenic lesions, often makes the diagnosis challenging.

pmc-13299913.title: Acute e chronic feasibility of left atrial appendage isolation focal ablation catheter toggling between radiofrequency and pulsed field energy
pmc-13299913.creator: M Marino, V M La Fazia, E Chiarazzo, C Gianni, S Mohanty, G Stifano, W Bode, K Awad, D Burkardt, J Gallinghouse, R Horton, A Al-Ahmad, L Di Biase, A Natale
pmc-13299913.description: BackgroundElectrical isolation of the left atrial appendage (LAA) has been shown to reduce arrhythmic recurrence in patients with long standing atrial fibrillation (AF); however, durable isolation remains a challenge.Purposeto demonstrate acute e chronic feasibility of LAA isolation in persistent AF patients with a focal ablation catheter toggling between radiofrequency (RF) and pulsed field energy (PFA).

pmc-13383269.title: Quinoidal Porphyrinoids as High-Performance Electron Acceptors for Organic Solar Cells: Design, Photophysics, and Device Optimization
pmc-13383269.creator: Rubén Caballero, Fernando Langa, Rahul Singhal, Ganesh D. Sharma, Pilar de la Cruz
pmc-13383269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Quinoidal porphyrinoids represent a promising class of electron accepting materials due to their extended π conjugation, strong electron affinity, and structural rigidity, yet their application in organic solar cells (OSCs) remains unexplored. This work presents the design and synthesis of a nickel based quinoidal porphyrinoid (NiQP) and its implementation as an n type acceptor in bulk heterojunction OSCs using PM6 as the donor polymer.

pmc-13482797.title: Social Media Influencer Marketing as a Clinical Trial Recruitment Modality: Tutorial Informed by One Study’s Approach
pmc-13482797.creator: Timothy B Plante, Jingyi Cao, Tamunotonye Harry, Yuanyuan Feng, Azuka Amaka Ngige, Hailey N Miller, Kayla Ferro, Marian E B Budu, Stephen P Juraschek
pmc-13482797.description: BackgroundInfluencer marketing (paid promotion by individuals with large, engaged social media followings) has become a major commercial advertising strategy, projected to reach US $32 billion globally in 2025. Clinical trials increasingly recruit through digital channels such as social media advertisements and patient portal messages.
